name: encode_accessible_genes
description: Per-biosample accessible gene sets from ENCODE ATAC-seq or DNase-seq peaks via promoter TSS overlap with UCSC refGene hg38

inputs.name: encode_manifest_tsv
inputs.description: Optional pre-downloaded manifest TSV with columns: file_accession, experiment_accession, biosample, href, output_type. If not provided, the ENCODE portal API is queried live at https://www.encodeproject.org/search/. Providing a manifest makes the run reproducible without network access.

inputs.name: refgene_gz
inputs.description: UCSC refGene.txt.gz for GRCh38/hg38. If not provided, auto-downloaded from https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/database/refGene.txt.gz and cached under out_dir/references/.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: ENCODE assay title to query. Use 'ATAC-seq' (default) or 'DNase-seq'.

parameters.name: output_type
parameters.help: ENCODE file output_type filter. Default 'IDR thresholded peaks'. For DNase use 'peaks'.

parameters.name: promoter_window
parameters.help: Half-width of promoter window around TSS in bp (default: 1000; promoter = TSS +/- 1000).

parameters.name: bin_size
parameters.help: Genome bin size in bp for region-to-promoter overlap (default: 1000).

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_<biosample>_accessible/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: GMT file with one gene set per biosample
